text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Justice minister Sevket Kazan says a key witness has been found in the mysterious car-bomb murder of secularist journalist Ugur Mumcu in 1993.
- Pop singer Yildiz Tilbe will include a Kurdish song in her new album.
- Eleven policemen on trial for alleged involvement in killing of leftist journalist are back at work.
- Tension between Ankara and Athens over Greek Cypriot deployment of Russian S-300 anti-aircraft missiles calms down.
- Islamist-led government gearing up for a change in the law on organised crime that would aid three recently arrested police special force members.
- Union of Women's Organisations warns Ankara against the preminence of Islamic religious groups.
- Istanbul Chamber of Commerce celebratees the 115th anniversary of its foundation.
- Turkomans will act as mediators between the rival Kurdish groups in nothern Iraq.
